main_import.title: Pham, La descente des cols par les onglets de Lefschetz, avec vues sur Gauss-Manin
main_import.passages_rechecked: PartII Section1.1, printed page26, physical PDF page17, formulas(1.5)′--(1.7); following parameter discussion read with its Thom-stratification warning.
main_import.imported_scope: Local Morse leading scalar determinant and local asymptotic framework. The finite-order coefficient is derived explicitly in the canonical note; parameter-uniform tails and actual full-cut matching use the retained internal carrier argument, not a general parameter assertion from Pham.

retained_analytic_mechanism.scope: Polynomial joint parameter/cut-length carriers and logarithmic tail bounds require m!=0, not gamma!=0. Disjoint limiting Morse balls retain separate local generators even if their critical values approach or agree.

new_analytic_argument: The first order-r scalar coefficient combines critical-action c1 with -1/2 of the log-Hessian derivative. Parity gives opposite coefficients in each pair. If Xi!=0, its sum and difference have nonzero orders r^5,r^6 and grouped dominance removes both coefficients of any constant period. Finite Taylor/asymptotic order only; no convergence or formal-block decomposition is claimed.
frontier: Morse/distinct-value quartic simultaneous gamma=Xi=0; finite critical degeneracies or value collisions; other cubic strata, uniform gates, coefficient schemes and lower-power GVC.
proof_boundary: Only exact chart, parity, stationary action and determinant coefficients, and specified regressions are checked. Parameter-uniform Morse expansion, global cut matching and grouped dominance are written analysis.
